notice: Supported M0-M3 requirements only; NOT_RUN is not an execution result. Historical M4/M5 are archived in docs/archive/scenarios-v3.json.

m2.negative_profile_assertion: Record actual observation; do not assume Linux must fail.

cases.title: Repeated four-VF enable and disable
actions: Provision slots before pci_enable_sriov.
Open and close each VF only under coordinator leases.
Disable VFs, destroy slots and sample ownership counters after each cycle.
assertions: All slots FREE with zero ledger after each completed cycle.
No VF PCI functions, VFIO fds, maps or pending events remain after owner close.
QEMU object counts and guest worker counts do not grow across cycles.

cases.title: Provision and PCI enable failure unwind

parameters.failure_points: every named provision, host-allocation and pci_enable_sriov stage

actions: Inject each named failure point independently.
Exercise successful reverse unwind and a second failure during unwind.
assertions: Successful unwind leaves slots FREE and resources fully released.
Unwind failure leaves FAILED and retained ledger for any possibly owned quota.
No capacity excess, hidden quota release or direct forced FREE transition.

cases.title: FILL, CRC and ring wraps
actions: Run FILL and CRC at every ring size through multiple wraps.
Run independent counter and phase model near uint32 wrap.
Verify buffers and every completion before publishing CQ_HEAD.
assertions: CRC polynomial 0xedb88320 with initial/final xor 0xffffffff matches the fixed vector.
Unread CQ is not overwritten and SQ indices remain within N.
Phase is published last and follows 1 ^ ((counter / N) & 1).
No duplicate outstanding ID in one epoch.

cases.title: Same IOVA in independent VF domains
actions: Map the same numeric IOVA to distinct buffers in independent VF containers.
Have A and B write different patterns and then run CRC.
assertions: A changes only its own buffer and B changes only its own buffer.
Both groups are independently viable and exclude PF and other VFs.
DMA source evidence shows the corresponding VF requester for SQ, payload and CQ.

cases.title: Unmapped address, guard page and permissions
actions: Map a target IOVA only in B and submit access from A.
Exercise guard-page and DMA permission failures.
Keep valid B traffic running and capture RID and fault counters.
assertions: A DMA fails without changing the B guard.
B valid traffic continues.
Every DMA helper return is checked; no uninitialized decode or infinite retry.
SQ or CQ fault fences and fails A; payload error completes DMA_ERROR only if CQ remains safe, then fences.
Partial cross-page writes are reported without promising rollback.

cases.title: VFIO device reset and open/close FLR
actions: Observe each real function-reset event and latch epoch after each new device fd.
Invoke VFIO_DEVICE_RESET and attempt traffic before fresh configuration.
Reconfigure and rearm with live session, epoch and ready_gen.
assertions: Standard FLR is advertised and VFIO reset works; mailbox reset is not substituted.
Each real reset increments epoch, cancels callbacks, clears old queue and pending vectors.
No DMA runs before new CONFIG_COMMIT and successful REARM.
Other VFs continue I/O.

cases.title: Reset under load with delayed tenant readiness
actions: Run tenant load while coordinator performs fence, quiesce and reset.
Delay new tenant mapping and READY in RECOVERING.
Complete exact-size old UNMAP, new MAP/config/READY and PF REARM.
assertions: RECOVERING remains fenced and does not change payload or CQ.
Quota remains allocated while old qcfg and indices clear.
Old buffers are freed only after owner UNMAP succeeds.
Traffic resumes only after new epoch/session and RUNNING readback.

cases.title: Delayed completion executes after reset
actions: Retain a real descriptor copy, token and CQ reservation using delay-cpl-ticks.
Reset the VF and configure a new ring.
Invoke the old completion callback through try-stale-cpl.
assertions: STALE_CPL increases because the actual callback was rejected at its final gate.
Old and new payload/CQ guards remain unchanged by the stale callback.
No stale VF interrupt is sent.
STALE_DESC and STALE_CPL are independent counters.

cases.title: Stale and malformed descriptors
actions: Submit old-epoch descriptors and malformed descriptors separately.
Exercise bounded decoder and checked arithmetic model under ASan/UBSan.
assertions: Old epoch only consumes SQ and increments STALE_DESC without payload/CQ DMA.
Invalid fields return BAD_DESC and never form an out-of-bounds access.
No undefined behavior, crash or stale completion is hidden by parser failure.

cases.title: Busy lease blocks disable and resize
actions: Keep a lease and device fd alive while requesting sriov_numvfs=0.
Attempt nonzero-to-nonzero VF count change.
Close owner, revoke lease, unbind and disable.
assertions: Busy operations return EBUSY or EPERM and preserve VF topology and quota.
Zero disable succeeds after the close protocol completes.
